test_moe_align_block_size_compare_implem: test the moe_align_block_size CUDA kernel against the Triton reference implementation across various block sizes, token counts, and expert configurations
test_moe_align_block_size_v2_large_num_e: test the moe_align_block_size v2 CUDA kernel for configurations with more than 1024 experts against the Triton reference
build_moe_align_block_size_triton: build a Triton JIT implementation of moe_align_block_size that counts tokens per expert, computes cumsum, pads block sizes, and sorts token IDs by expert
build_moe_align_block_size_stages: build four Triton JIT kernel stages for moe_align_block_size: stage1 counts tokens per expert, stage2 computes prefix sum, stage3 calculates padded totals, stage4 sorts tokens into expert blocks
run_moe_align_block_size_test: run parameterized pytest tests for moe_align_block_size comparing CUDA and Triton implementations with varying block_size, num_tokens, topk, and num_experts
